content.comment_body: Hello! When I insert the memory card into the slot, it fails to read and displays a 'Card unknown' message. I have tried several memory cards, but the same error occurs each time. Is there anything I can do to resolve this? Device: [product_name] [article_no]. Transferring the program using the PC connection works fine and the program loads on the device, but the memory card does not work. Thank you.
The SD card needs to be formatted with FAT32, otherwise the device won't recognize it. Try formatting your SD card to FAT32 and see if that resolves the issue.
Did you manage to resolve this issue? I have also attempted using various SD cards with different cluster sizes and FAT32 formatting, but none are detected by the [product_name] [article_no].
A new question published by [user_name] was moved to a separate thread, with the subject 'SD card read/write error' appearing during diagnostics. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulties with their devices not recognizing SD cards, even after trying different cards and FAT32 formatting. While program transfer via PC connection works, SD card recognition continues to fail, and suggested troubleshooting steps have not led to a universal solution. This issue blocks users from reliable memory card usage in their devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that the memory card slot should reliably detect and accept correctly formatted SD cards without errors, allowing for seamless data transfer and storage.
